headline: Public hearings on National Grid's Fulton Street location petition and proposed zoning changes for vacant and foreclosing properties.
summary: Residents can comment at public hearings on a National Grid petition for 60-157 Fulton Street and proposed zoning changes for vacant and foreclosing properties. The agenda also includes mayoral funding requests, a resolution on the sale of Cataldo Ambulance Service, and a Fire Department drone use policy.
items: Resolution inviting residents to the MAMAS Free Store on November 14th and the City's Winter Preparedness Event on November 19th
Public Works and Facilities Committee report from October 21, 2026
Public hearing on National Grid petition for grant of location at 60-157 Fulton Street
Public hearing on proposed zoning amendments, Chapter 94, Vacant and Foreclosing Properties
Resolution asking the administration for an update on the recent vacancy in the Veterans Department
Resolution to approve a joint press release on Medford High School project next steps
Resolution inquiring into the contractual and community impacts of the sale of Cataldo Ambulance Service
Mayor's capital and general stabilization fund appropriation request for the police chief search
Mayor's capital and general stabilization fund appropriation requests
Mayor's supplemental appropriation for fiscal year 2027 for the Law Department
Fire Department unmanned aircraft system use policy under the CCOPS ordinance
Tabled: appointment of a City Messenger for 2026 and 2027
Tabled: resolution to update the ordinance establishing the Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities
location: City Council Chamber, 2nd Floor, Medford City Hall, 85 George P. Hassett Drive, Medford, MA, and via Zoom
